abi: Custom EAX = archive, ECX = context; cdecl(fileName, topPointer, bottomPointer); EAX returns script pointer.
semantics: The wrapper publishes archive at 92223c and context at 922240 before calling 52bcb0 with six arguments: out-script local, context, file name, archive, top pointer and bottom pointer. The zero-initialized output local is represented by the portable Parse service return value.

On normal child return the wrapper clears both context globals, even if the returned script is null or later fails. A null result returns zero; otherwise the same script pointer is returned after finalization.

Each state condition resolves its target-name word20 against the owning script states and stores the state pointer at24. The name is read again before this store and diagnostic check. Nonnull unresolved targets emit a mode-dependent 512850/512860 diagnostic with target name, script name and current state name.
For each state the wrapper scans every later state and reports all duplicate names. It neither removes duplicates nor aborts; case folding preserves native ASCII and extended-byte behavior.
The low-level per-file parser remains explicit here; this wrapper closes condition goto-target pointers needed between raw production, initialization and runtime evaluation.
domains: Mapped bounded script/state/condition graphs and NUL byte names; acyclic lists. The child output local is caller-disjoint scratch and normalized into an explicit pointer result.

Native diagnostics are observed RET no-ops; no mutation or messaging is implied. One invalid child script pointer fault preserves cleared context globals. Machine fault registers and exception type are excluded.
The native wrapper, state lookup and comparison children execute actual original bytes. Only 52bcb0 parser output is supplied. Managed replay is compiled and unexecuted.
